item.title: Russia’s election data show 2 classic fingerprints of manipu…
item.author: Max B 💙 🔶 🇺🇦 🇬🇧 🇪🇺 (@maxbrockbank.com)
item.description:
Russia’s election data show 2 classic fingerprints of manipulation: as turnout rises, United Russia’s vote rises with it, creating the blue “comet tail”; repeated round-number results form dotted lines. Both are associated with ballot stuffing.

Putin doesn’t even pretend any more.
